note: The desktop cat (sub-project H). A spot is the cat's head centre in points, y down, the origin at the top left of the main screen. phases: the seven phases and what each means. steps: desktopStep(state, event) is out, for every phase and event and for input that is not a phase or an event. trips: desktopStep over a script of events, out is the state and act after each. flights: desktopFlightAt(from, to, t) is out. sizeCases: desktopSizeOf(raw) is out. fpsCases: desktopFps(input) is out. kittenSlots: desktopKittenSlots(kittens, side) is out (a missing side is not given). kittenSizes: the same layout in points at each size, side 1. screenKeys: screenKey(screens) is out. isScreenKey: isScreenKey(key) is out. clamps: clampSpot(spot, screens, size). defaultSpots: defaultDesktopSpot(screens, size). spotFor: spotFor(spots, screens, size). remembers: rememberSpot(spots, screens, spot, size). spotMaps: cleanDesktopSpots(raw). A screen is {frame, visible, main}; a missing size is not given. settingsCases: cleanDesktopSettings(raw) is out.

catchNote: The file catch. A file on its way into the island (dragged over it, waiting for the cat, or its drop flow on screen) is an alert to the desktop cat: alertOn and alertOff to desktopStep, so there is no new phase, event or act. alertCases: desktopAlert(input) is out (a flag counts only when it is exactly true). catchReady: desktopCatchReady(phase) is out (the cat is at the notch). catchWaitMs: how long a dropped file waits for the cat, in ms. The trips named "a file catch" are desktopStep over the events the file catch sends.

offerNote: The incoming transfer offer. A card from another machine ("<name> wants to send <file>") waits for a click: an alert to the desktop cat, like an approval, so it is alertOn and alertOff to desktopStep and there is no new phase, event or act. offerCases: desktopAlert(input) is out for inputs that carry transferOffer (a flag counts only when it is exactly true). alertCases is unchanged and holds no transferOffer. The trips named "a transfer offer" are desktopStep over the events an offer sends.
